segments.title: mind as the only creator

spans.eng: all the living beings of the universe
mind and what comes along with it

spans.tib: las kyang sems la brten pa
spans.eng: karma itself depends on the mind

spans.tib: byed pa po gzhan 'gog par bstan la
spans.eng: the point is that there is no other creator of things than the mind itself.

segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment proposed independently by Codex (English-first). The single med pa is omitted because its negation is distributed across GMR's two coordinated uses of no; this is not a null judgment. Modal and causal hinges remain unwrapped, and the final denial stays a depth-3 recast. C16:817 has identical ACIP, Wylie, and English; ILL:2687 offers a shorter comparative rendering of the same closing extent, without proving publication or ingestion lineage.
